name: Ninja Clandestine Manipulator
body:
A clandestine manipulator combines mystical training and arcane study of enchantment magic to bend another’s will in subtle ways, elevating espionage and sabotage to a whole new level.

A clandestine manipulator has the following class features.

Class Skills

A clandestine manipulator adds Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft to her list of class skills.

This alters class skills.

Blade In The Back (Ex)

At 1st level, a clandestine manipulator learns to take advantage of unprepared foes, striking them in a vital spot for extra damage. A clandestine manipulator can use this ability when her target would be denied a Dexterity bonus to AC (whether the target actually has a Dexterity bonus or not), or when the clandestine manipulator flanks her target. A clandestine manipulator must declare that she is using this ability before making her attack roll (thus, a failed attack roll ruins the attempt). If a blade in the back attack is successful, the target suffers precision damage equal to +1d6. This damage increases by +1d6 for every 3 levels beyond 1st, to a maximum of +7d6 at 19th level.

A clandestine manipulator can attempt a blade in the back attack 3 times per day, plus one additional time per day for every five clandestine manipulator levels, and no more than once per round.

This replaces poison use.

Manipulative Magic

At 1st level, a clandestine manipulator gains the ability to cast arcane spells. A clandestine manipulator’s spell list contains all the spells of the enchantment school from the bard and sorcerer/wizard spell lists up to 6th level, excluding all else. A clandestine manipulator uses the bard spell tables to determine her base daily spell allotment and her spells known, and like a bard, she can cast any spell she knows without preparing it ahead of time. To learn or cast a spell, a clandestine manipulator must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a clandestine manipulator’s spell is 10 + the spell level + the clandestine manipulator’s Charisma modifier. A clandestine manipulator must spend 1 hour conducting mental exercises after getting 8 hours of sleep to prepare her mind to cast spells for the day.

This replaces sneak attack and all of its iterations.

Ninja Tricks

A clandestine manipulator cannot benefit from ninja tricks that enhance or interact with sneak attack unless she has the sneak attack class feature from another class.

This alters ninja tricks.

Power of Persuasion (Ex)

At 3rd level, a clandestine manipulator can use her bonus in the Profession (con artist) skill in place of her bonus in another skill. When substituting in this way, the clandestine manipulator uses her total Profession skill bonus, including class skill bonus, in place of the substituted skill’s bonus, whether or not she has ranks in that skill. The skills that a clandestine manipulator can use Profession (con artist) to substitute for are: Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, Intimidate, Linguistics, and Sense Motive. At 3rd level, a clandestine manipulator chooses two skills from this list for which she can use Profession (con artist) in place of. This choice is permanent and cannot be changed.

At 6th level, a clandestine manipulator gains a +1 competence bonus to her Profession (con artist) skill checks. This bonus increases by +1 at 9th level, and every three levels thereafter, to a maximum of +5 at 18th level.

This replaces no trace and all of its improvements.

Aura of Despair (Su)

At 8th level, a clandestine manipulator gains the wizard’s enchantment school power aura of despair. This aura is activated as a free action.

This replaces improved uncanny dodge.

Sap Reserves (Su)

At 20th level, whenever a clandestine manipulator successfully uses her blade in the back ability, she can sacrifice additional damage dice to apply a penalty to one ability score of the target equal to the number of dice sacrificed for 1 minute. This penalty does not stack with itself and cannot reduce an ability score below 1.

This replaces the portion of hidden master that pertains to sneak attack; all other aspects of hidden master remain unchanged.
